Fix move numbering when starting from a FEN

Fix move numbering when starting from a FEN

As a result, a session started from a FEN was numbered from 1 as if
White moved first.

Fix pawn color on terminals that draw U+265F as an emoji

Use the outline glyphs (U+2654-U+2659) for every piece and tell the sides
apart by color only. The filled pawn (U+265F) is also an emoji, and terminals
that render it with an emoji font ignored the color, so pawns showed up purple.

Bump version to 0.1.1.
